senses.gloss: [to round, shape, denom. טֶבַע, fr. which טָבַע]

units: Snh. IV, 5 (37ᵃ) אדם טוֹבֵעַ כמה מטבעות וכ׳, v. חוֹתָם; Y. ib. VI, 22ᵇ bot.; a. e.—Trnsf. to formulate.
<cite ref="Gittin 5b">Gitt. 5ᵇ</cite>, a. e. <he>כל המשנה ממטבע שטָבְעוּ וכ׳</he> he who deviates from the formula of the deed of divorce which the scholars have fixed.
<cite ref="Berakhot 40b:3">Ber. 40ᵇ</cite> <he>כל המשנה … שט׳ … בברכות</he> he who changes the formula of benedictions which &c.; a. fr.

<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 20">Num. R. s. 20</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Deuteronomy 27:12">Deut. XXVII, 12</cite>, sq.) <he>בברכות היה מזכירן … לא היה טוֹבְעָן</he> in ordering blessings He mentioned them (the people) …, but in ordering curses He did not mention them explicitly; (Tanḥ. Balak 12 <he>לא היה מזכירם</he>; ed. Bub. 18 <he>תובען</he>, <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 766">Yalk. Num. 766</cite> <he>תובעין</he>, incorr.)
